asr.full_text: I like movies about all kinds of monsters out there. They definitely get the attention of the audience. But one thing is when monsters are small, like toothpastes. Another thing is when monsters the size of a skyscraper are destroying everything in their way. Like Godzilla. Hello! You're on the FOX TV channel. And in today's issue I'm going to tell you about the biggest monsters in the movie. The worm uses a pinch to catch its prey and pull it into its mouth. It cannot see, but it can hear perfectly. Any source of sound can become its prey. It is true that it can spit out undigested things. Its body is very strong, its skin is difficult to pierce. But the main character of the film still finds ways to kill these monsters. There was a huge beetle, a tank. Somehow it could dig tunnels in the ground and appear at the most unsuitable times. Besides it was huge in size and very strong, and it was hard to break through. Its main weapon was fire breath. It was watering its enemies with some kind of flammable acid. It just burned bodies with bones. It was usually possible to kill it. Hans is a troll hunter and he kills him using the projectors in his trailer. Then we meet another. There were other trolls. But we're interested in the final one, the biggest, growing at 50 meters. He's chasing their trailer. Some time, and at times like this. We can see this monster. He moves further. The creator of the film, Jay-Jay Abrams, hinted that this is just a baby, and the real fun will start when his mom comes after him. However, it's been eight years, and the sequel hasn't come out yet. From the cracks in the depths of the ocean, huge monsters have started to come out. The monsters that can destroy all of humanity. The Kaidu. That's what they were called in the movie Pacific Rim. And this is the next giant monster in our line. The Kaidu in this film was a lot, and they were very different in size and power. So they were assigned categories from 0 to 5. The smallest monster is the Kaidu category. The newest monster, but it was very aggressive. Well, it was the age and the power of the year. And this is the first monster in this movie. The game is a monster that was invented by the Japanese during the course of these films, the monster changed a lot with each film, but we got better. It was first remembered by the American film by Roland Emmerich. And finally, the biggest monster I've ever found. This is the final monster from the comedy-fantasy movie Evolution. The plot follows a meteorite falling in the Arizona desert. The site of the fall was discovered by single-celled living organisms. They evolved and mutated very quickly, and the most of them were animals. And then there were different mutants and new species of animals. And finally, this all ended up in this giant monster. And this is probably one of the biggest in the history of cinema. I could have missed a lot of interesting monsters, and I'd be happy if you could write in the comments about who I missed. And if you want to watch the monsters in this video, then in the video description I'll put links to all the movies specifically for you so you don't have to look for them. And friends, don't forget to subscribe to the channel, I have a lot of interesting videos.
